scientific_integrity: An explicit analytic proof uses the published triangle-defect part criterion; numerical checks are finite diagnostic tests, not an exhaustive certificate. The initiating manuscript and two close published research results were read materially and compared by implication. Historical priority and independent validation have not been certified.
scientific_limitations: Real finite-dimensional additive ell_p plus Euclidean norms only, 1<p<infinity, n>=2. The complete part classification and leading logarithmic boundary rate are proved; no exact finite-parameter metric formula or infinite-dimensional extension is claimed. Unindexed priority overlaps remain possible.
title: Hilbert regularization separates intrinsic parts of mixed \(\ell_p\) norms
